text:
maya-support: Hey @jess-customer — saw your ticket. You said the dashboard legend colors don't match the series on mobile and tooltips show wrong values, right? Can you paste a repro and the org id?
jess-customer: Org 98765. On iPhone Safari, compact dashboard. Steps: open Insights > select last 24h > tap series legend to highlight — wrong series highlights, tooltip shows value from a different series. Screenshot: https://redwood.assets/screengrabs/98765/legend_mismatch.jpg
maya-support: thanks. Is this happening on desktop too or only iOS compact? Any console errors?
jess-customer: Only on mobile, desktop is fine. No obvious network errors, but we saw weird billing spike around the same time which prompted the report.

tom-frontend: jumping in — can you check if this is the new analytics frontend bundle? We rolled out 2025-06-12 08:15 UTC to canary/mobile. Could be CSS z-index or hit-target overlay. Quick question: does the highlight correspond to index offset (i.e., the Nth legend item highlights N+1 series)?
lee-analytics: adding analytics context — we rolled the new ingestion pipeline at 2025-06-12 08:00 UTC which introduced a dedupe pass. There was a replay job that started at 08:10 and could have duplicated series keys for a short window. If series keys duplicated, legend rendering code might tie colors to series id vs index.

marco-mobile: iPhone 14 / iOS 17 / Safari. Repro steps from my side: compact vertical layout -> legend uses flex-wrap, but we apply overflow: auto; touch tap target seems to register on the element below when wrapping occurs. CSS snippet causing trouble:```css
.legend { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:8px; }
.legend-item { min-width:56px; padding:4px 6px; }
.chart-area { pointer-events:auto; }
```
Tap targets shrink too small when container width recalculates, so taps fall through to chart canvas -> tooltip picks up the datapoint under the tap.

tom-frontend: that matches the symptom. Tooltip showing wrong series value could be because the tap event reaches the canvas, generating a tooltip for the nearest point. Two issues then: (A) legend hitboxes small on compact; (B) legend-color-to-series mapping may be relying on DOM order while data order changed because of duplicates.

maya-support: can we repro with the API directly to confirm duplicate series? lee, any quick query we can run?

lee-analytics: run this debug query against metrics-read:```sql
SELECT series_key, COUNT(*) as cnt, MIN(ts) as first_seen
FROM infra.metrics
WHERE org_id = 98765 AND ts BETWEEN '2025-06-12T07:50:00Z' AND '2025-06-12T08:30:00Z'
GROUP BY series_key
ORDER BY cnt DESC
LIMIT 20;
```
If cnt > 1 for same series_key then ingestion replay introduced duplicates. Also you can fetch series list used by the chart via the dashboard API:```bash
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY' "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/orgs/98765/dashboards/388/series?from=2025-06-12T07:50:00Z&to=2025-06-12T08:30:00Z" | jq .
```
That returns the series array and color assignments.

jess-customer: I ran the curl above and I see two identical series entries with different color indexes. Pinged support with the output.

marco-mobile: so combined bug: duplicate series can change color indexing, and compact legend's small hitbox means taps go to canvas. Fix path: (1) stop duplication at ingest; (2) make legend hitbox full-width and pointer-events:block so taps don't fall through.

tom-frontend: quick patch I can do for canary: add .legend-item { padding:8px 12px; touch-action: manipulation; pointer-events:auto; } and ensure legend uses HTML button with aria-labels (improves hitbox). Can push to canary/mobile only. Do we want to rollback analytics ingestion first to stop duplicates?

lee-analytics: we can roll back the replay job for the 08:10 window — I'll schedule a rollback of the dedupe/replay job right now. If anyone needs to revert the frontend canary instead, say so.

maya-support: @deploy-bot please initiate a canary rollback for analytics-replay job on org 98765 time window 2025-06-12T08:10:00Z..2025-06-12T08:25:00Z
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Received command. Initiating rollback for job analytics-replay/2025-06-12T08:10Z..2025-06-12T08:25Z. Status: queued.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Rollback completed for analytics-replay. Duration: 3m22s. No failures.

tom-frontend: I've opened PR #4621 with the legend hitbox change and small accessibility tweaks. Can push to canary/mobile and then to prod if no regressions. Patch diff:```diff
- .legend-item { min-width:56px; padding:4px 6px; }
+ .legend-item { min-width:64px; padding:8px 12px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; }
```

marco-mobile: testing the canary build now on iPhone Safari — initial look: legend tap now selects the legend item and tooltip matches highlighted series. No more mis-highlights in 10 taps. :thumbsup:

jess-customer: Confirmed on our end. Legend selection matches series and billing spike vanished after rollback. Thanks!

maya-support: marking as investigating->resolved in ticket tracker RED-3129. Please file a follow-up for analytics to add an ingestion invariant test around replay duplicates.

lee-analytics: will add a regression test in the ingestion CI and monitor replay job metrics for duplicates. Linking to issue RED-3130.

maya-support: closing thread here but filed follow-ups: RED-3129 (customer fix), RED-3130 (ingestion test). Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
